title: Commands
description: How tempjs commands fit together — use this page as a map, then drill into template pages for generated commands.

blocks.text: tempjs commands fall into two groups: generation (run in an empty client folder) and maintenance (run inside a project that already has .tempjs.json). Generation copies the template; maintenance commands like theme, brand, and init-db modify an existing install without re-copying files.
For copy-paste commands tailored to hotel or real-estate — including step-by-step flag picking — open the template guide in the sidebar and use the command generator.

tempjs <template-id> copies files. Add config to run setup after copy, or use the template id followed by config for interactive prompts. --yes skips confirmations; --force overwrites conflicting files.
Run these from the project root where .tempjs.json exists. They update constants/site.ts, globals.css theme tokens, or .env without touching unrelated files.
